At N8 Upper Cervical in Makati, Metro Manila we use extremely precise advanced Upper Cervical Chiropractic techniques to improve the health and life of our patients. 

Upper Cervical Chiropractic care is a very gentle technique that does not utilize twisting, popping or cracking. Our safe approach has proved extremely effective for those suffering from a variety of chronic conditions including migraines, vertigo, fibromyalgia, back pain, neck pain, TMJ and more. 

To schedule a consultation with Dr. Miguel & Gabriel Flores please call our office in Alabang at (02) 835-62098 and at our Makati office at 63 2-8553-6218.
To learn more about our practice visit our website at 
https://n8uppercervicalchiropractic.com/

We would love to see if our unique form of care can help you find the relief you have been looking for.

If would like to learn even more about Upper Cervical Care please visit https://uppercervicalawareness.com/
